title: Encoded maximum-cut problem
statement: Let $V$ be finite, and choose canonical binary encodings for maximum-cut instances on $V$ and assignments of signs to $V$. The well-formed inputs are the canonical encodings of instances. An input and output are feasible exactly when both decode successfully; their value is the instance value of the decoded assignment when both decode, and is $0$ otherwise. The stated optimum is the decoded instance's optimum when the input decodes, and is $0$ otherwise.
